core: Run a local Yoke server in containers.
core build: Build a local Yoke server image from a checkout.
core logs: Print the local server's API and database logs.
core start: Start the local Yoke database and API containers.
core status: Show whether the local server is installed and healthy.
core stop: Stop the local server containers, keeping their data.
core upgrade: Upgrade the local server and restart its API.
